rejectedCandidate.reason: A new wrapper test would not prove current population or field-policy authority, would duplicate existing direct V2 coverage, and could not exercise the package-private People owner adapter plus Approval quorum from one package.

finalPinPolicy.finalRule: After concurrent Wave5 integration settles, fetch once and record clean pushed dwp-dev heads. Compare the HRM-010/V2 relevant paths with their integrated evidence pins; any relevant production drift withholds no-code closure.

targetedFinalVerification.databaseExecutionPolicy: Do not rerun PostgreSQL suites while Docker is unavailable and then treat disabledWithoutDocker skips as a pass. Reuse the immutable HRM-010 zero-skipped evidence only if all relevant production paths are unchanged. If a relevant path changed or a PostgreSQL rerun becomes necessary, Docker readiness and JUnit XML skipped=0 are mandatory gates.
prohibitedVerification: a PostgreSQL command that can silently pass with skipped tests

gatesBeforeClosure.check: The six-row conformance matrix uses direct V2, owner PEP, Approval quorum and zero-skipped HRM-010 evidence without inventing callback claims.
No production, test-source, frontend, shared Approval or migration delta remains.
Final clean pushed dwp-dev backend and frontend SHAs have not yet been pinned after concurrent Wave5 work.
The final-pin relevant-path diff and the three narrow non-Docker verification commands have not yet been recorded.
Control has not yet issued the no-code closure receipt and selected BASE-TFR-HRM-002.

closureProcedure: Commit and push the corrected Control documents to frontend dwp-dev.
Wait for concurrent dwp-dev integration activity to settle, then fetch and verify both default checkouts are clean and equal origin/dwp-dev.
Record the final pins and prove relevant HRM-010/V2 paths are unchanged from the accepted implementation/evidence.
Run only the three narrow non-Docker commands and verify their selected tests executed.
Issue a no-code closure receipt; do not create a Start Token, worktree, branch or migration.
Notify HRIS-HRM that BASE-TFR-HRM-001 closed by conformance and select BASE-TFR-HRM-002.

failurePolicy.relevantPathChanged: Withhold closure and audit only the changed path against the six-row matrix.
failurePolicy.targetedTestFailure: Withhold closure and report the exact failing invariant; do not authorize a source edit automatically.
failurePolicy.postgresRerunNeededWhileDockerUnavailabl: Withhold closure until Docker is ready; a skipped suite is not evidence.
failurePolicy.newProductionRequirement: Prepare a separate exact source-delta authority and keep this no-code preparation closed.
